healthy.example_en: My little brother stays healthy by playing football after school.
healthy.example_zh: 我弟弟放学后踢足球，身体一直很健康。

heavy.example_en: The heavy suitcase was hard to lift onto the bus.
heavy.example_zh: 那个很重的行李箱很难抬上公交车。

helpful.example_en: Our neighbour was helpful when Mum hurt her ankle.
helpful.example_zh: 妈妈扭伤脚踝时，邻居帮了大忙。

high.example_en: The high shelf in the kitchen is hard to reach.
high.example_zh: 厨房里那层高架子很难够到。

historic.example_en: We visited a historic castle during the weekend trip.
historic.example_zh: 周末出游时，我们参观了一座有历史意义的城堡。

historical.example_en: The museum showed historical photos of our town.
historical.example_zh: 博物馆展出了我们小镇的历史照片。

honest.example_en: Please be honest with me if you broke the window.
honest.example_zh: 如果是你打碎了窗户，请对我说实话。

hot.example_en: The soup was too hot to drink at lunch.
hot.example_zh: 午饭的汤太烫了，没法马上喝。

human.example_en: Human babies need care from their parents for years.
human.example_zh: 人类的婴儿需要父母照顾很多年。

hungry.example_en: I felt hungry after the long football match.
hungry.example_zh: 踢完那场很长的足球赛后，我感到很饿。

ideal.example_en: Sunny weather is ideal for a picnic in the park.
ideal.example_zh: 晴朗的天气最适合在公园野餐。

ill.example_en: Tom stayed home because he felt ill this morning.
ill.example_zh: 汤姆今早病了，所以留在家里。

illegal.example_en: Parking on the pavement is illegal in our city.
illegal.example_zh: 在我们这座城市，把车停在人行道上是非法的。

immediate.example_en: The cut needed immediate care from the school nurse.
immediate.example_zh: 这个伤口需要校医立即处理。

impossible.example_en: Finishing the puzzle in one minute seemed impossible.
impossible.example_zh: 一分钟内拼完这幅拼图似乎不可能。

impressive.example_en: Her painting of the lake was impressive at the show.
impressive.example_zh: 她画的那幅湖景在展览上令人印象深刻。

Indian.example_en: We tried Indian food at a restaurant near the school.
Indian.example_zh: 我们在学校附近的餐馆吃了印度菜。

individual.example_en: Each student received individual feedback on the essay.
individual.example_zh: 每个学生都收到了针对作文的个别反馈。

industrial.example_en: Smoke rose from the industrial area outside the town.
industrial.example_zh: 城外的工业区升起了烟。

informal.example_en: We wore informal clothes to the weekend barbecue.
informal.example_zh: 周末烧烤时，我们穿了便服。

inner.example_en: The inner pocket of my coat held the bus ticket.
inner.example_zh: 我外套里面的口袋装着公交票。

innovative.example_en: The science club built an innovative model of a bridge.
innovative.example_zh: 科学社团做了一个创新的桥梁模型。

intellectual.example_en: Chess is an intellectual game my uncle loves.
intellectual.example_zh: 国际象棋是我叔叔喜欢的智力游戏。

interested.example_en: Lucy is interested in joining the school choir.
interested.example_zh: 露西对加入学校合唱团很感兴趣。

interesting.example_en: The documentary about whales was interesting for our class.
interesting.example_zh: 那部关于鲸鱼的纪录片我们班觉得很有趣。

internal.example_en: The doctor checked for internal injuries after the fall.
internal.example_zh: 摔倒之后，医生检查了有没有内伤。

international.example_en: An international student joined our class this term.
international.example_zh: 这学期有一位国际学生加入了我们班。

Irish.example_en: My cousin studies Irish dancing on Saturday afternoons.
Irish.example_zh: 我表姐每个星期六下午学爱尔兰舞。

Islamic.example_en: The family prepares special food for Islamic festivals.
Islamic.example_zh: 这家人会为伊斯兰节日准备特别的食物。

Israeli.example_en: An Israeli coach visited our basketball team last month.
Israeli.example_zh: 上个月一位以色列教练来看望了我们篮球队。

Italian.example_en: Dad cooked Italian pasta for Sunday dinner.
Italian.example_zh: 爸爸星期天的晚饭做了意大利面。

Japanese.example_en: We learned a Japanese song for the school concert.
Japanese.example_zh: 我们为学校音乐会学了一首日本歌。

Jewish.example_en: Their Jewish neighbours shared bread during the holiday.
Jewish.example_zh: 节日期间，他们的犹太邻居分享了面包。

joint.example_en: The two classes made a joint poster for Sports Day.
joint.example_zh: 两个班为运动会做了一张共同的海报。

key.example_en: Timing is a key skill in the relay race.
key.example_zh: 在接力赛里，把握时机是一项关键技能。

large.example_en: A large dog waited outside the bakery for its owner.
large.example_zh: 一只大狗在面包店外面等它的主人。

legal.example_en: A driving licence is the legal proof that you may drive.
legal.example_zh: 驾驶证是你可以开车的合法证明。

likely.example_en: Rain is likely this afternoon, so take a coat.
likely.example_zh: 今天下午很可能下雨，所以带件外套。

local.example_en: We buy vegetables at the local market every weekend.
local.example_zh: 我们每个周末都在当地市场买菜。

long.example_en: The long queue for tickets stretched around the stadium.
long.example_zh: 买票的长队绕着体育场排开。

loud.example_en: The loud music from next door kept the baby awake.
loud.example_zh: 隔壁大声的音乐吵得宝宝睡不着。

lovely.example_en: The kitten has a lovely face and soft fur.
lovely.example_zh: 这只小猫脸很可爱，毛也很柔软。

low.example_en: The baby is sleeping, so our voices stay low.
low.example_zh: 宝宝在睡觉，所以我们把声音放得很低。

mad.example_en: Dad got mad when the dog chewed his shoe.
mad.example_zh: 狗咬坏了他的鞋，爸爸很生气。

main.example_en: The main entrance of the school faces the bus stop.
main.example_zh: 学校的正门对着公交车站。

major.example_en: Flooding was a major problem after the heavy rain.
major.example_zh: 大雨之后，积水成了主要问题。

male.example_en: The male swimmers lined up at the pool's deep end.
male.example_zh: 男游泳运动员在泳池深水区一端排好了队。

manual.example_en: This old camera is manual and has no screen.
manual.example_zh: 这台旧相机是手动的，没有屏幕。

married.example_en: My uncle is married and lives with my aunt.
married.example_zh: 我叔叔已经结婚了，和我阿姨住在一起。

massive.example_en: A massive wave knocked the small boat sideways.
massive.example_zh: 一个巨浪把小船打得歪到一边。

maximum.example_en: The maximum speed on this road is thirty kilometres an hour.
maximum.example_zh: 这条路的最高时速是三十公里。

medical.example_en: The clinic offers free medical checks for schoolchildren.
medical.example_zh: 这家诊所为学龄儿童提供免费体检。

mental.example_en: Too little sleep can harm your mental health.
mental.example_zh: 睡眠太少会损害你的心理健康。

mere.example_en: A mere five minutes was enough for us to miss the bus.
mere.example_zh: 仅仅五分钟就让我们错过了公交车。

military.example_en: My uncle wore his military uniform at the parade.
military.example_zh: 我叔叔在游行时穿着军装。

minimum.example_en: The minimum age for this ride is twelve years.
minimum.example_zh: 玩这个游乐项目的最低年龄是十二岁。

miserable.example_en: Ben felt miserable after losing his favourite pencil case.
miserable.example_zh: 本丢了最喜欢的铅笔盒，难过极了。

mixed.example_en: The mixed salad had tomatoes, cheese, and cold chicken.
mixed.example_zh: 这份混合沙拉里有番茄、奶酪和冷鸡肉。

mobile.example_en: My mobile phone buzzed during the quiet exam.
mobile.example_zh: 安静的考试中，我的手机突然震动了。

modern.example_en: The modern gym has bright lights and new machines.
modern.example_zh: 这座现代体育馆灯光很亮，还有新器械。

monthly.example_en: Our monthly test covers maths and science on the first Monday.
monthly.example_zh: 我们的月考在第一个星期一考数学和科学。

moral.example_en: Parents expect moral behaviour from children at the dinner table.
moral.example_zh: 父母希望孩子在餐桌上有合乎道德的举止。

multiple.example_en: The form asks for multiple phone numbers in case of emergency.
multiple.example_zh: 表格要求填写多个应急电话号码。

narrow.example_en: The narrow lane behind the school is too tight for cars.
narrow.example_zh: 学校后面的窄巷子，汽车开不进去。

nasty.example_en: The nasty weather cancelled our outdoor PE lesson.
nasty.example_zh: 恶劣的天气让我们的室外体育课取消了。

national.example_en: The national flag flies above the town hall.
national.example_zh: 国旗在市政厅上空飘扬。

natural.example_en: The natural light in the art room is good for painting.
natural.example_zh: 美术室的自然光很适合画画。

naughty.example_en: The naughty puppy pulled the washing off the line.
naughty.example_zh: 那只调皮的小狗把晾着的衣服扯了下来。

necessary.example_en: Warm coats are necessary when the winter wind is strong.
necessary.example_zh: 冬天风大时，厚外套是必要的。

negative.example_en: Try not to give a negative reply before you listen.
negative.example_zh: 听别人说完之前，尽量不要给出否定的答复。

new.example_en: I bought a new pair of trainers for PE.
new.example_zh: 我买了一双新运动鞋，上体育课穿。

nice.example_en: Mrs Lee is nice and always greets us at the gate.
nice.example_zh: 李老师人很好，总是在校门口跟我们打招呼。

normal.example_en: It is normal to feel nervous before an exam.
normal.example_zh: 考试前感到紧张是正常的。

northern.example_en: Birds fly to northern lakes when spring arrives.
northern.example_zh: 春天来临时，鸟儿会飞向北方的湖泊。

numerous.example_en: Numerous stars were visible from the dark hillside.
numerous.example_zh: 从漆黑的山坡上能看见许多星星。

occasional.example_en: An occasional bus runs to the village after dusk.
occasional.example_zh: 黄昏后，偶尔有一班公交车开往那个村子。

odd.example_en: An odd noise came from the fridge at midnight.
odd.example_zh: 半夜冰箱里传来一阵奇怪的响声。

ok.example_en: Is it ok if I borrow your ruler for maths?
ok.example_zh: 数学课上我借一下你的尺子，可以吗？

OK.example_en: The rice tastes OK, though it needs a little salt.
OK.example_zh: 米饭的味道还行，不过需要加一点盐。

okay.example_en: The printed photo looks okay after we fixed the light.
okay.example_zh: 我们调好光线后，打印出来的照片看起来还行。

old.example_en: My old bicycle still gets me to school on time.
old.example_zh: 我的旧自行车还能让我按时到校。

Olympic.example_en: She dreams of winning an Olympic medal in swimming.
Olympic.example_zh: 她梦想在游泳项目上赢得一枚奥运奖牌。

ongoing.example_en: The ongoing repair of the bridge slows the morning traffic.
ongoing.example_zh: 大桥正在持续维修，早高峰的交通变慢了。

open.example_en: Leave the window open so the kitchen stays cool.
open.example_zh: 让窗户开着，这样厨房能凉快一些。

ordinary.example_en: We ate ordinary bread and soup for dinner at home.
ordinary.example_zh: 我们在家晚饭吃了普通的面包和汤。

organisational.example_en: Good organisational skills help when you plan a party.
organisational.example_zh: 组织能力好，筹划聚会时会轻松很多。

outstanding.example_en: Maya gave an outstanding performance in the school play.
outstanding.example_zh: 玛雅在校园剧中的表演非常出色。

packed.example_en: The packed train left many passengers standing near the doors.
packed.example_zh: 挤满人的火车上，许多乘客站在车门旁边。

Palestinian.example_en: The Palestinian flag uses black, white, green, and red.
Palestinian.example_zh: 巴勒斯坦国旗使用黑、白、绿、红四种颜色。

particular.example_en: Is there a particular seat you want on the bus?
particular.example_zh: 公交车上有没有你特别想坐的座位？

past.example_en: In past years our school held the fair in May.
past.example_zh: 过去几年，我们学校都在五月举办义卖会。

perfect.example_en: The weather was perfect for flying kites on Sunday.
perfect.example_zh: 星期天的天气非常适合放风筝。

permanent.example_en: Ink from that pen leaves a permanent mark on shirts.
permanent.example_zh: 那种钢笔的墨水会在衬衫上留下永久的印记。

personal.example_en: Each pupil has a personal locker in the changing room.
personal.example_zh: 每个学生在更衣室都有一个个人储物柜。

pink.example_en: She tied a pink ribbon around the birthday gift.
pink.example_zh: 她在生日礼物上系了一条粉红色丝带。

plain.example_en: She wore a plain dress to the family dinner.
plain.example_zh: 她穿了一条朴素的裙子去参加家庭晚餐。

plastic.example_en: Do not put plastic bags into the hot oven.
plastic.example_zh: 不要把塑料袋放进热烤箱里。

pleasant.example_en: A pleasant breeze cooled us during the picnic.
pleasant.example_zh: 野餐时，一阵令人愉快的微风让我们凉快下来。

pleased.example_en: Mum was pleased with my improved maths score.
pleased.example_zh: 妈妈对我提高后的数学成绩很高兴。

political.example_en: The mayor gave a political speech in the town square.
political.example_zh: 市长在镇广场上发表了政治演讲。

poor.example_en: The poor family received food from the neighbours.
poor.example_zh: 那户贫穷的家庭收到了邻居送来的食物。

popular.example_en: Football is popular among students at our school.
popular.example_zh: 足球在我们学校的学生当中很受欢迎。

posh.example_en: The posh hotel near the station costs too much.
posh.example_zh: 车站附近那家豪华酒店价钱太高了。

positive.example_en: His positive reply meant we could use the hall.
positive.example_zh: 他肯定的答复意味着我们可以使用礼堂。

possible.example_en: Is it possible to finish the poster before lunch?
possible.example_zh: 午饭前把海报做完，有可能吗？

practical.example_en: These practical shoes are good for walking to school.
practical.example_zh: 这双实用的鞋很适合走路去上学。

precise.example_en: The recipe needs a precise amount of sugar.
precise.example_zh: 这个食谱需要精确的用糖量。

pregnant.example_en: My aunt is pregnant and avoids lifting heavy boxes.
pregnant.example_zh: 我阿姨怀孕了，避免搬重箱子。

previous.example_en: The previous owner left a map inside the drawer.
previous.example_zh: 以前的主人在抽屉里留下了一张地图。

primary.example_en: Children start primary school around the age of six.
primary.example_zh: 孩子们大约六岁开始上小学。

prior.example_en: You need prior permission before using the science lab.
prior.example_zh: 使用科学实验室之前，你需要事先得到许可。

private.example_en: The private garden behind the house is locked at night.
private.example_zh: 屋后的私人花园晚上会锁上。

professional.example_en: A professional pianist played at our end-of-term concert.
professional.example_zh: 一位专业钢琴家在我们的期末音乐会上演奏。

proper.example_en: Wear proper shoes when you run on the track.
proper.example_zh: 在跑道上跑步时要穿合适的鞋子。

public.example_en: The public library stays open until eight in the evening.
public.example_zh: 公共图书馆开放到晚上八点。

pure.example_en: The mountain stream looks pure enough to drink.
pure.example_zh: 山里的溪水看起来纯净得可以直接喝。

rare.example_en: Snow is rare in our city, even in January.
rare.example_zh: 即使在一月，我们这座城市也很少下雪。

ready.example_en: Are you ready for the spelling test this afternoon?
ready.example_zh: 你准备好今天下午的拼写测验了吗？

real.example_en: The film used real animals instead of drawings.
real.example_zh: 这部电影用了真实的动物，而不是图画。

realistic.example_en: A realistic plan includes time for homework and rest.
realistic.example_zh: 一个现实的计划会包含写作业和休息的时间。

reasonable.example_en: Ten yuan is a reasonable price for this notebook.
reasonable.example_zh: 这本笔记本卖十元，价格很合理。

recent.example_en: A recent storm broke several branches in the park.
recent.example_zh: 最近的一场暴风雨折断了公园里的几根树枝。

red.example_en: Her red scarf stood out in the snowy playground.
red.example_zh: 她的红围巾在积雪的操场上很显眼。

regional.example_en: Our team won the regional final in basketball.
regional.example_zh: 我们队赢得了篮球赛的地区决赛。

registered.example_en: Only registered players may enter the school tournament.
registered.example_zh: 只有注册过的选手才能参加学校的锦标赛。

regular.example_en: Regular exercise helps you sleep better at night.
regular.example_zh: 有规律的锻炼能帮助你晚上睡得更好。

related.example_en: These two maths problems are related and share a method.
related.example_zh: 这两道数学题是相关的，而且解法相同。

religious.example_en: Many religious festivals include special family meals.
religious.example_zh: 许多宗教节日都包含特别的家庭聚餐。

remarkable.example_en: Her remarkable memory lets her recall every classmate's birthday.
remarkable.example_zh: 她的记忆力了不起，能记住每位同学的生日。

remote.example_en: The remote village has no shop and one small school.
remote.example_zh: 那个偏远的村子没有商店，只有一所小学校。

retail.example_en: Retail prices at the mall are higher than at the market.
retail.example_zh: 商场里的零售价比菜市场更高。

rich.example_en: A rich family donated books to our school library.
rich.example_zh: 一个富有的家庭向我们学校图书馆捐赠了图书。

rotten.example_en: Throw away the rotten apple before it spoils the others.
rotten.example_zh: 把腐烂的苹果扔掉，免得弄坏其他水果。

rough.example_en: The rough towel felt uncomfortable against my sunburn.
rough.example_zh: 粗糙的毛巾蹭在晒伤处，感觉很不舒服。

rude.example_en: It is rude to talk with your mouth full of food.
rude.example_zh: 嘴里塞满食物时说话是无礼的。

rural.example_en: My grandparents live a quiet rural life among the fields.
rural.example_zh: 我的爷爷奶奶在田野间过着宁静的乡村生活。

Russian.example_en: We watched a Russian cartoon with Chinese subtitles.
Russian.example_zh: 我们看了一部带中文字幕的俄罗斯动画片。

sad.example_en: A sad film left the whole family quiet after dinner.
sad.example_zh: 一部悲伤的电影让全家人晚饭后都安静下来。

safe.example_en: The children are safe inside during the thunderstorm.
safe.example_zh: 雷雨的时候，孩子们安全地待在室内。

scared.example_en: The little boy was scared of the barking dog.
scared.example_zh: 小男孩害怕那只汪汪叫的狗。

scientific.example_en: The scientific method starts with a clear question.
scientific.example_zh: 科学方法从提出一个清楚的问题开始。

secondary.example_en: Secondary students often stay at school for club activities.
secondary.example_zh: 中学生常常留在学校参加社团活动。

secret.example_en: She wrote the secret message in tiny letters.
secret.example_zh: 她用很小的字写下了那条秘密信息。

senior.example_en: The senior students organised the sports day stalls.
senior.example_zh: 高年级学生组织了运动会的摊位。

sensitive.example_en: My skin is sensitive and turns red in strong sun.
sensitive.example_zh: 我的皮肤很敏感，烈日下会变红。

separate.example_en: Raw chicken stays separate from the salad in our fridge.
separate.example_zh: 生鸡肉和沙拉在我们冰箱里是分开放的。

serious.example_en: Dad's serious face told us the news was bad.
serious.example_zh: 爸爸严肃的表情告诉我们，这个消息不好。

several.example_en: Several students missed the bus because of the rain.
several.example_zh: 因为下雨，几个学生错过了公交车。

severe.example_en: The severe cold forced us to wear two coats.
severe.example_zh: 严寒迫使我们穿上了两件外套。

sexual.example_en: The biology textbook has a chapter on sexual reproduction in plants.
sexual.example_zh: 生物课本里有一章讲植物的有性生殖。

sharp.example_en: That sharp knife belongs in the drawer, away from children.
sharp.example_zh: 那把锋利的刀应该放在抽屉里，远离孩子。

short.example_en: The short break between lessons is only ten minutes.
short.example_zh: 两节课之间的短暂休息只有十分钟。

sick.example_en: Jake is sick today and will miss the maths test.
sick.example_zh: 杰克今天病了，会错过数学测验。

silly.example_en: Wearing socks on your hands looks silly at the party.
silly.example_zh: 在聚会上把袜子套在手上，看起来很傻。

similar.example_en: These two maps look similar but show different years.
similar.example_zh: 这两张地图看起来相似，但年份并不相同。

simple.example_en: A simple sandwich is enough for a quick lunch.
simple.example_zh: 一个简单的三明治就够一顿快速的午餐。

single.example_en: There is a single apple left in the fruit bowl.
single.example_zh: 水果碗里只剩下一个苹果。

slight.example_en: A slight delay made us late for the first lesson.
slight.example_zh: 稍有耽搁，我们就第一节课迟到了。

slow.example_en: The slow bus crawled through the morning traffic.
slow.example_zh: 那辆慢公交车在早高峰车流里一点点往前挪。

small.example_en: A small bird built its nest above our door.
small.example_zh: 一只小鸟在我们家门的上方筑了巢。

social.example_en: Litter in the park is a social problem near our school.
social.example_zh: 公园里的垃圾是我们学校附近的一个社会问题。

soft.example_en: The soft pillow helped me sleep on the train.
soft.example_zh: 柔软的枕头帮我在火车上睡着了。

solid.example_en: The solid table can hold a heavy stack of books.
solid.example_zh: 这张结实的桌子能放下厚厚一摞书。

sore.example_en: My sore throat made it hard to sing in the choir.
sore.example_zh: 我嗓子疼，很难在合唱团里唱歌。

southern.example_en: Southern cities stay warm even in late December.
southern.example_zh: 南方的城市即使到十二月下旬也很暖和。

Soviet.example_en: The museum keeps a Soviet poster from the last century.
Soviet.example_zh: 博物馆保存着一张上世纪的苏联海报。

Spanish.example_en: Our class cooked a Spanish omelette during cooking class.
Spanish.example_zh: 我们班在烹饪课上做了西班牙蛋饼。

spare.example_en: I left a spare key with the neighbour upstairs.
spare.example_zh: 我把一把备用钥匙留在了楼上的邻居那里。

special.example_en: Mum cooked a special meal for Grandma's birthday.
special.example_zh: 妈妈为奶奶的生日做了一顿特别的饭。

specific.example_en: The coach set a specific time for the extra practice.
specific.example_zh: 教练为加练定了一个具体的时间。

spectacular.example_en: The spectacular fireworks lit the river on New Year's Eve.
spectacular.example_zh: 壮观的烟花在除夕夜照亮了河面。

spiritual.example_en: The temple visit gave her a spiritual feeling of peace.
spiritual.example_zh: 参观寺庙给了她一种精神上的平静。

square.example_en: We ate lunch at a square table in the canteen.
square.example_zh: 我们在食堂的一张方桌旁吃了午饭。

stable.example_en: The ladder felt stable when Dad climbed onto the roof.
stable.example_zh: 爸爸爬上屋顶时，梯子感觉很稳。

sticky.example_en: The sticky honey dripped onto the breakfast table.
sticky.example_zh: 黏糊糊的蜂蜜滴到了早餐桌上。

strange.example_en: A strange cat followed us home from the park.
strange.example_zh: 一只陌生的猫从公园跟着我们回了家。

strategic.example_en: The coach made a strategic change during the second half.
strategic.example_zh: 教练在下半场做了一次战略调整。

strict.example_en: Our strict teacher checks homework at the start of every lesson.
strict.example_zh: 我们严格的老师每节课开始时都会检查作业。

strong.example_en: Tom is strong enough to carry the heavy box upstairs.
strong.example_zh: 汤姆很强壮，能把沉重的箱子搬上楼。

stuck.example_en: The stuck window would not open in the heat.
stuck.example_zh: 那扇卡住的窗户在大热天打不开。

stupid.example_en: Leaving my phone on the bus was a stupid mistake.
stupid.example_zh: 把手机落在公交车上是个愚蠢的错误。

subsequent.example_en: Subsequent lessons built on the grammar from Monday.
subsequent.example_zh: 随后的课都建立在星期一学的语法之上。

substantial.example_en: We made a substantial donation of books to the library.
substantial.example_zh: 我们向图书馆捐赠了大量图书。

successful.example_en: The successful experiment produced a bright blue liquid.
successful.example_zh: 这次成功的实验做出了一种亮蓝色液体。

sudden.example_en: A sudden shower sent everyone running under the trees.
sudden.example_zh: 突然下起阵雨，大家都跑到树下躲避。

superb.example_en: The superb meal at Grandma's house needed no extra salt.
superb.example_zh: 奶奶家那顿极好的饭菜完全不用再加盐。

sure.example_en: Are you sure the homework is in your backpack?
sure.example_zh: 你确定作业在你的背包里吗？

surprised.example_en: I was surprised when my drawing won first prize.
surprised.example_zh: 我的画得了一等奖，我感到很惊讶。

surprising.example_en: The surprising result was a draw after extra time.
surprising.example_zh: 令人惊讶的结果是加时之后打成了平局。

sustainable.example_en: Sustainable farming uses less water and fewer chemicals.
sustainable.example_zh: 可持续的耕作方式用水更少，化学品也更少。

sweet.example_en: The sweet mangoes from the market were gone by evening.
sweet.example_zh: 从市场买来的甜芒果到傍晚就吃完了。

tall.example_en: The tall player could reach the basket without jumping.
tall.example_zh: 那位高个子队员不用起跳就能碰到篮筐。

technical.example_en: The technical problem stopped the online class for ten minutes.
technical.example_zh: 技术故障让网课停了十分钟。
